output.review_comment: The PR makes the tests pass, and the taxable-flag filter and half-up rounding are real fixes. But switching to per-line rounding contradicts the docstring, which says tax is "computed once on the whole taxable base, not line by line", and the PR doesn't update or flag it. It was done only to make test_invoice_with_several_items return 296. The whole-base rule gives 3598*825/10000 = 296.835, which rounds half-up to 297, and no rounding on the whole base passes every test. So the test and the docstring conflict, and that needs to go back to the teammate/tax team instead of being silently settled by changing behavior and calling it a bug fix. The code also mixes models: it checks base <= 0 on the combined total but computes tax per line, which leaves credit-line behavior unclear. Please raise the conflict. If per-line rounding is confirmed, update the docstring and define how credit lines are rounded. Otherwise, the test needs the tax team's review.
